# Comment-density waivers for .github/ci/check_comment_density.py
#
# One `path # reason` per line, the path relative to the repo root (fnmatch
# globs allowed). The reason is mandatory and is printed next to the file every
# run, so a waiver has to keep justifying itself out loud.
#
# A waiver is for a file that genuinely earns more prose than the 18% ceiling --
# not for evidence that has not been moved to docs/perf/ yet. If the comments
# are measured numbers, ratio tables, A/B results, saturation ladders or
# bracketing cells, the fix is docs/perf/<op>.md plus an
# `evidence: docs/perf/<page>.md#<anchor>` pointer, not a line here.
#
# A waiver that matches no scanned file is an error: delete it when the file
# goes, rather than leaving the gate open for whatever takes that name next.
#
# Public headers (include/batchlas/, include/batchlas.hh) do not need a waiver
# for their Doxygen API documentation: `///`, `//!`, `/** */` and `/*! */`
# comment lines there are in neither count. That covers the contract only
# (brief, params, returns, preconditions, throws, complexity); rationale in a
# doc comment is still rationale and belongs in docs/. See
# docs/developer/documentation.md#writing-api-documentation.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# BURN-DOWN ASSESSMENT, 2026-10-06. 24 files remain waived, down from 137
# on 2026-09-15. Two changes did most of it, and neither deleted interface
# (a further 7 lines went with the files they waived when the level-3
# cuBLASDx fused and *_custom_dispatch sources were deleted):
#   - the public-API doc-comment exemption (2026-09-30) stopped counting the
#     Doxygen contract in include/batchlas/, which moved every waived public
#     header under the ceiling (sycl_interop.hh, settings.hh and error.hh were
#     the worst, at 86%, 78% and 73%);
#   - the Doxygen documentation pass moved the lab-notebook prose of the
#     src/ files into docs/perf/ and docs/design/, leaving a trap or an
#     invariant plus an `evidence:` pointer. 82 waiver lines went at once.
# What is left is mostly tests/ and benchmarks/ (whose comments describe the
# guard each case is built around) plus a few short src/ headers whose
# remaining lines are traps. The remedy is the same as before: relocate
# prose into docs/ with an `evidence:` anchor, in the same commit as the
# target heading (.github/ci/check_evidence_anchors.py resolves every
# pointer), then delete the line here. Earlier assessment, 2026-09-15:
# tests/sg_compat_tests.cc went 19.27% -> 14.13% by deleting 18 banner-rule
# lines and nothing else.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------

src/util/resident_capacity.hh                    # 45 lines of constexpr helpers, one invariant each (barrier scope, the non-monotone walk, the single budget spelling); every measured number is in docs/perf/potrf.md#the-shared-helper-budget-slice-walk-and-pack
src/extensions/geqrf_tiny_device.hh              # 129 lines of constexpr gates and tables, 16 invariants each of which breaks silently (the ceil8 bank rule, the pin, the one-step fixed point, the odd tile stride, the separate y vector, no reqd_work_group_size); every measured number is in docs/perf/qr.md#the-tiny-tier-register-table, #the-chunk-width-and-the-one-cell-that-is-pinned and #the-two-partition-butterflies. 36.45% -> 20.73%; the remaining 5 lines cannot go without deleting a rationale.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# BATCH WAIVER, 2026-09-11. The 18% ceiling was introduced by the small-n
# factorization campaign after these files were written, and the repo
# aggregate (133 of the tree's files were listed here; 29 remain on
# 2026-10-06) hid the per-file problem for years. They are waived EXPLICITLY, one line each
# rather than by glob, so that a NEW file over the ceiling still fails the
# gate on the day it is written. Burn these down opportunistically: delete
# a line when you bring its file into band. Do NOT add to this block.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
